title.narrative: OEGI- LMS-Regional Resilience Learning Associate Award

description.narrative: (USAID East Africa Regional): Using FY 2022 funds, USAID/Kenya and East Africa (KEA) will continue the implementation of a demand-driven regional learning agenda activity to ensure that resilience interventions are based on evidence and appropriate to the regional context. The Resilience Learning Activity (RLA) will continue its work to facilitate more responsive and geographically customized analytics through meta-analysis of data across targeted East African stakeholders. To increase analytical capacities, RLA will organize regional virtual data analytics training, building on the Horn of Africa Resilience Network (HoRN) learning sessions conducted in 2022, and will launch a community of practice with a group of professionals who will use data analytics, monitoring, and evaluation for evidence-based decision making to improve regional resilience against recurrent shocks and stresses. .The Resilience Learning Activity (RLA) is aligned with USAID's goals and the Horn of Africa (HOA) Resilience Framework. It strengthens capacities for analytics in resilience, facilitates learning for adaptive management, and improves knowledge management and communication. .RLA is co-funded by the Bureau of Humanitarian Assistance, USAID/Somalia, and the USAID/KEA operating units which support local, regional, and national organizations and institutions in the HOA. RLA will contribute to USAID/KEA being a center for excellence in resilience programming via coordination and leveraging cross-learning in the HOA region across six USAID resilience focus countries... .
